Dear Member:

Pinnacle Health Plan has completed review of the inpatient admission identified above. Based on the clinical information submitted, we have issued an adverse determination on the basis of medical necessity. The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODES
CARC CO-50
RARC N115

CRITERIA APPLIED
Review was conducted using the InterQual-style criteria set applicable to the admission under review. The following criteria codes were found not met:

PNA-01: Pneumonia severity scores indicated low risk suitable for outpatient treatment.

PNA-02: The patient did not have hypoxemia requiring inpatient oxygen.

No other criteria codes were applied in reaching this determination. This adverse determination on medical necessity applies to the inpatient admission spanning [[ADMIT_DATE]] to [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] as submitted under claim number CLM86927291720.

APPEAL RIGHTS AND INSTRUCTIONS
The member, or a representative acting on the member's behalf with written authorization, may request a Level 1 appeal of this adverse determination. Level 1 appeals may be submitted by letter or by portal upload.

When submitting an appeal, please cite the applicable criteria codes inline within the body of the appeal narrative, specifically PNA-01 and PNA-02, and state the basis on which each is contested. Attach the History and Physical and all progress notes for the admission under review. Appeal submissions are subject to a five page limit, exclusive of the attached medical records.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Submissions received after that time may not be eligible for Level 1 review.

A physician reviewer participated in this determination. Upon request, Pinnacle Health Plan will provide the name of the criteria set applied and information regarding the review process at no charge to the member.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Pinnacle Health Plan
